candidates.reason: Selected after the frozen checkpoint-2 screen and prospective 40-action calibration; checkpoint 3 adds grouped schemas, composed paths, and custom types.

headroom_rule.advance: Checkpoint 3 has no infrastructure failure, normalized Core is at least 0.50, normalized all-test score is at least 0.50, and the worker issues COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT before action 40 at every attempted checkpoint.
headroom_rule.strong_advance: Checkpoint-3 Core is complete and normalized all-test score is below 0.95, providing both a reliable local-success source and broader-score headroom.
headroom_rule.reject: Stop the cfgpipe sequential contrast if checkpoint-3 Core or all-test score is below 0.50, or if checkpoint 3 is action-boundary censored.
headroom_rule.formal_if_valid: Freeze a three-layer no_transfer versus recursive_self_report_synthesis pilot with two workers per arm and the same 40-action per-checkpoint budget.

outcome_plan.primary: Mean normalized all-test score at each checkpoint, because the mechanism concerns globally inferior behavior that can remain locally plausible.
outcome_plan.secondary: Mean normalized Core score and exact failure overlap.
